g.text: Internal OOF outcomes on 120 development paths per client; primary state mesh = 0.05

text.style: font-size: 11.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Growth = exp(mean annual net real log growth) - 1. Transfers / H decisions, averaged over paths; initial trades included.

text.style: font-size: 11.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Five frozen 96/24 splits; overlapping training sets. Pooled OOF counts are descriptive, not independent safety certificates.

text.style: font-size: 11.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Gate initial allocation is optional; annual/hold initial allocation is mandatory. Dynamic rules inherit no risk approval.

text.style: font-size: 11.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Mesh 0.025: same B/C/E breach counts; 1/6,120 paired finite-H actions differ. This is not an error bound.
